Anthropic released new Mythos and Fable models with improved coding, reasoning, and vision capabilities.

glance.headline: Apple adds paid AI usage packs
glance.summary: Apple updated Logic Pro with an option to buy more usage for some Apple Intelligence features for a one-time purchase price of $49.99.
Disney and Adobe are partnering to create proprietary generative AI models for production pipelines.

big_pour.headline: Nvidia CEO under scrutiny for alleged affair
big_pour.summary: Nvidia is investigating whether its CEO had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. The company is looking into whether this relationship was a target for Chinese intelligence.
big_pour.why: This investigation could impact the leadership and strategic direction of a major global AI chip supplier.

explain.kid: The boss of a big computer chip company might be in trouble because he had a secret relationship with someone who might be a spy for another country.
explain.product manager: Nvidia is investigating if its CEO was targeted by intelligence from a foreign country through an affair, which is being treated as a national security issue.
explain.software engineer: Nvidia is running an internal probe to determine if its CEO was targeted by foreign intelligence through an affair, evaluating the situation as a national security concern.

big_pour.headline: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models
big_pour.summary: Anthropic has released new Mythos and Fable models. The company states these models show improvements in coding, reasoning, vision, and user communication.

big_pour.headline: Apple adds paid AI usage packs
big_pour.summary: Apple updated Logic Pro with an option to buy more usage for some Apple Intelligence features for a one-time purchase price of $49.99.

office_blend.headline: CrossnoKaye uses AI for heavy industry
office_blend.summary: CrossnoKaye uses Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to ground AI reasoning in live plant data. The system provides plant engineers with verifiable, math-backed answers.

office_blend.headline: Northern Trust automates client onboarding
office_blend.summary: Northern Trust launched an AI-powered agent to streamline institutional client onboarding. The agent standardizes years of transaction history for reporting.

still_roasting.summary: Disney and Adobe are developing proprietary artist-led generative AI models for Disney's production pipeline.
Amazon is rolling out a feature that allows users to text Alexa to help them shop.

quick_sips.summary: Instagram launched an Effect Builder that generates custom filters for Stories using AI prompts for US residents over 18.
Meta released Muse Ember, a lightweight model for agent execution that is priced at 10 cents per million input tokens.
Medium launched a new writing app that integrates AI assistance directly into the writing process.

stories.label: New system
stories.headline: Google introduces open-source TPU Sync
stories.summary: Google released TPU Sync, an open-source system designed to speed up AI inference by over 90%.

stories.label: Open source
stories.headline: Google donates AI infrastructure projects
stories.summary: Google is donating three core AI agent infrastructure projects, including the code sandbox gVisor, to open source.

concept.explanation: gVisor is a code sandbox used by Anthropic and OpenAI to provide secure environments for running code.

long_read.headline: The AI Industry Thinks It Has a PR Problem
long_read.summary: The newsletter suggests that the political impact of the AI industry is more significant than its public relations challenges.

sign_off: That's the last sip. See you next morning.

word.definition: Low-Rank Adaptation, a cheap way to fine-tune that trains a small set of extra weights instead of changing the whole model.
word.heard: "We shipped a LoRA adapter instead of a full fine-tune."
word.analogy: Like teaching a new recipe card rather than retraining the barista from scratch.
